summary.quantification_method: Relative ion abundance (AUC) of isotopic pairs

primary_variables.matched_definition: Addition of an extracellular signaling molecule such as a cytokine, growth factor, hormone, or receptor ligand to activate a biological state.
evidence: binding of FVIII results in partial formation of 12 of the VWF bonds
Human recombinant full-length FVIII was added to the plasmas at a FVIII:VWF monomer molar ratio of ∼1:4 and incubated for 30 minutes.

primary_variables.matched_definition: Mechanical perturbation by fluid shear or flow.
evidence: Exposure of VWF to pathological fluid shear forces ex vivo and in vivo causes partial cleavage of all 13 disulfide bonds
Healthy donor plasma was subjected to physiological (2000 s−1) and pathophysiological (10 000 s−1) fluid shear forces.

primary_variables.matched_definition: Comparison between diseased and healthy or unaffected controls.
evidence: Six of the 13 VWF TIL’-TIL3 disulfides were significantly (P < .001) more reduced in patients with heart failure receiving ECMO than in patients not receiving this mechanical assist
Human recombinant full-length FVIII was added to the plasmas at a FVIII:VWF monomer molar ratio of ∼1:4 and incubated for 30 minutes.
healthy donor plasma was sheared at rates of 2000 or 10 000 s−1 for 5 minutes at room temperature using a Kinexus pro+ rheometer.
Six of the 13 VWF TIL’-TIL3 disulfides were significantly (P < .001) more reduced in patients with heart failure receiving ECMO than in patients not receiving this mechanical assist

control_arms: patients not receiving this mechanical assist
case_arms: patients with heart failure receiving ECMO
replicate_hints: Analysis of a single plasma sample on 3 separate occasions
multiplex_channel_hints: differential cysteine alkylation with a pair of isotopic alkylators (12C-IPA and 13C-IPA)

evidence: The mean redox states of 11 of the 12 VWF TIL’-TIL3 disulfides were more oxidized when bound to FVIII (P < .05)
